name: study-assistant-desktop
description: macOS Desktop Overlay App for Study Assistant

scripts.postinstall: electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && cd ../server && npx electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 -e ../desktop/node_modules/electron
scripts.dev: npm run build:main:once && concurrently "npm run build:main:watch" "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:5173 NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.rebuild:native: electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && cd ../server && npx electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 -e ../desktop/node_modules/electron
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:main:once && vite build
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run package
